quests.title: A Copper Storehouse
quests.subtitle: Capacity
description: Begin with an expanded chest for mixed supplies. Drawers still suit bulk goods; these chests hold varied stacks.

quests.title: An Iron Reserve
description: Upgrade your general storage before the workshop outgrows its walls.

quests.title: A Golden Treasury
description: Move the tools and components you use most into a larger store.

quests.title: Room to Expand
description: Reserve a diamond chest for the finished products of several production lines.

quests.title: The Strongroom
description: Finish a durable vault for valuable stock. Claims and trusted access remain your protection against other players.

quests.title: Keep the Contents
quests.subtitle: Upgrades
description: Use an upgrade on an existing wooden chest instead of emptying its contents into a replacement.

quests.title: A Growing Warehouse
description: Carry the same store forward into iron.

quests.title: Investment in Capacity
description: Expand the warehouse one tier at a time.

quests.title: The Diamond Standard
description: Prepare an in-place diamond upgrade for a busy store.

quests.title: Reinforce the Vault
description: Bring the final upgrade to the chest already serving your workshop.

quests.title: The Display Case
quests.subtitle: Display
description: A crystal chest shows its contents. Use a few for displays rather than a wall of rendered inventory.

quests.title: A Humble Beginning
description: Even a vault has room for a little dirt.

quests.title: Expect Trouble
quests.subtitle: Preparation
description: Bring a shield and leave valuables at home before opening a lucky block.

quests.title: An Escape Plan
description: Carry water for falls and fire. Luck can turn an ordinary outing into a rescue.

quests.title: Emergency Rations
description: Keep an emergency meal on your hotbar.

quests.title: A Roll of Fate
description: Open lucky blocks away from settlements, machines and other players. A reward is never guaranteed.

quests.title: A Fortunate Blade
quests.subtitle: Prizes
description: Recover a lucky sword and try its unpredictable effects in a safe wilderness clearing.

quests.title: An Uncertain Arrow
description: Recover a lucky bow. Treat every shot as an experiment and keep it away from protected builds.

quests.title: Bottled Chance
description: Recover a lucky potion. Its name is no promise of safety.

quests.title: The Witch's Garden
quests.subtitle: Garden
description: Establish a small belladonna bed for the first workings.

quests.title: A Restless Root
description: Harvest mandrake with space to react to whatever the soil releases.

quests.title: Winter in Bloom
description: Grow snowbell alongside your other ritual herbs.

quests.title: Roots in Water
description: Add a water-grown herb to the garden.

quests.title: A Rowan Grove
description: Set aside a grove of ritual trees outside your crowded workshop.

quests.title: The Alder Stand
description: Keep a renewable supply of alder for later workings.

quests.title: Thorns and Branches
description: Complete the three-tree garden with hawthorn.

quests.title: Smoke and Ash
quests.subtitle: Oven
description: Build a witch's oven and keep jars available for its by-products.

quests.title: Catch the Vapour
description: Prepare fired jars before processing ingredients.

quests.title: What the Fire Leaves
description: Gather ash from the oven for your early mixtures.

quests.title: The Horned One's Breath
description: Collect the first of the oven's named fumes.

quests.title: A Gentler Breath
description: Collect a second fume and keep the bottles sorted.

quests.title: A Trace of Magic
description: Reserve this fume for the workings ahead.

quests.title: Guide the Smoke
description: Improve the oven with a fume funnel.

quests.title: A Cleaner Harvest
description: Finish the filtered funnel branch before scaling the apothecary.

quests.title: A Place of Power
quests.subtitle: Altar
description: Build an altar with a varied natural garden around it. Leave room for its supporting objects.

quests.title: The Ritual Blade
description: Prepare an arthana for your altar and rituals.

quests.title: An Offering Vessel
description: Add a chalice to your ritual equipment.

quests.title: Three Small Flames
description: Complete the altar furnishings with a candelabra.

quests.title: A Stone That Remembers
description: Attune a stone for more demanding magic.

quests.title: Stored Power
description: Charge the stone before attempting workings that require it.

quests.title: Separate the Essence
quests.subtitle: Alchemy
description: Build a distillery and organise the ingredients it transforms.

quests.title: The First Brew
description: Prepare a kettle for brewing.

quests.title: A Deeper Vessel
description: Move into cauldron workings once your herb supply is reliable.

quests.title: Change Takes Root
description: Use mutandis to seek new plants. Work in a contained garden.

quests.title: Stranger Growth
description: Prepare the stronger mixture for the next stage of experimentation.

quests.title: Draw the Boundary
quests.subtitle: Circles
description: Mark a ritual space with chalk and leave its interior clear.

quests.title: The Heart of the Circle
description: Prepare golden chalk for the central marks.

quests.title: Fire in the Pattern
description: Add nether chalk to your ritual supplies.

quests.title: Beyond the Circle
description: Prepare otherwhere chalk for distant workings.

quests.title: A Pattern Preserved
description: Store a circle pattern in a talisman.

quests.title: A Small Guardian
quests.subtitle: Wards
description: Begin with a plain poppet before binding a protective working.

quests.title: A Personal Link
description: Prepare a taglock kit. Bind protection to yourself or a willing companion.

quests.title: A Place for Wards
description: Keep active wards in an organised poppet shelf.

quests.title: Against the Deep
description: Prepare a water protection poppet before long underwater journeys.

quests.title: Against the Flame
description: Prepare a fire protection poppet for dangerous expeditions.

quests.title: A Familiar Shape
quests.subtitle: Travel
description: Make the broom that will carry your next working.

quests.title: The Flight Mixture
description: Prepare flying ointment for the enchanted broomstick.

quests.title: Above the Garden
description: Finish your broomstick and take the old road through the sky.

quests.title: A Crimson Discovery
quests.subtitle: Knowledge
description: Study a vampire fang before deciding whether to embrace the curse or hunt it.

quests.title: The Vampire Codex
description: Keep the guide nearby. Vampire and hunter paths are alternatives; neither requires completing the other.

quests.title: The Darkened Forest
description: Find the vampire forest and prepare a route home.

quests.title: Accept the Night
quests.subtitle: Vampire
description: Choose the vampire path and complete its initiation.

quests.title: The First Thirst
description: Feed for the first time as a vampire.

quests.title: An Altar of Inspiration
description: Build the first altar for your vampire progression.

quests.title: A Deeper Infusion
description: Prepare the infusion altar and consult the guide for each rank's requirements.

quests.title: Wings of Night
description: Unlock the vampire's bat transformation.

quests.title: Master of the Night
description: Reach the vampire path's maximum level.

quests.title: Take the Hunter's Oath
quests.subtitle: Hunter
description: Choose the hunter path. This branch is an alternative to becoming a vampire.

quests.title: Wood Against Darkness
description: Prepare a stake for your hunts.

quests.title: A Hunter's Bench
description: Build the station that supports your progression.

quests.title: Keep Your Distance
description: Equip a basic crossbow and prepare ammunition.

quests.title: A Seasoned Hunter
description: Upgrade your crossbow before facing stronger foes.

quests.title: The Veteran's Oath
description: Reach the hunter path's maximum level.

quests.title: A Stored Reserve
quests.subtitle: Bloodcraft
description: Keep blood in bottles for the workings that need it.

quests.title: A Proper Cellar
description: Build a container for a larger blood supply.

quests.title: The Bloodworks
description: Prepare a grinder as part of your blood-processing setup.

quests.title: Refine the Supply
description: Add a sieve to complete the processing branch.

quests.title: Metal and Blood
description: Create blood-infused iron for specialised equipment.

quests.title: An Enhanced Alloy
description: Refine the infused metal further.

quests.title: A Little Shade
quests.subtitle: Survival
description: Carry an umbrella when sunlight threatens your journey.

quests.title: Prepared for Daylight
description: Prepare a potion table and consult the guide for daylight protection.

quests.title: A Sheltered Domain
description: Build a sunscreen beacon for a permanent refuge.

quests.title: Another Choice
description: Study the potion of oblivion before choosing to leave your path.

quests.title: A Lord's Responsibility
quests.subtitle: Retinue
description: Earn lord status before recruiting a retinue.

quests.title: Names Worth Remembering
description: Give a companion a name rather than raising an unmanageable crowd.

quests.title: A Trusted Guardian
description: Complete the guide's protection milestone with a minion.

quests.title: The Mark of the Beast
quests.subtitle: Moon
description: Find a werewolf tooth and study the path before accepting its changes.

quests.title: A Place Beneath the Moon
description: Prepare a stone altar for werewolf progression.

quests.title: Fire at the Altar
description: Add the altar's fire bowl and follow the werewolf guide's rites.

quests.title: A Bone-Wrought Charm
description: Prepare a necklace for the path ahead.

quests.title: A Bound Charm
description: Add a charm bracelet to your equipment.

quests.title: Dreams Held Fast
description: Craft a dream catcher for your moonbound collection.

quests.title: A Pale Vein
quests.subtitle: Silver
description: Mine silver and reserve part of the yield for defensive supplies.

quests.title: Refined Moonlight
description: Smelt a silver reserve.

quests.title: A Silver Edge
description: Prepare a silver weapon for encounters with werewolves.

quests.title: A Hunter's Answer
description: Make silver ammunition for ranged defence.

quests.title: Armour of Silver
description: Complete the core of your silver equipment.

quests.title: A Hunter's Trophy
quests.subtitle: Pelts
description: Gather a pelt from a dangerous encounter.

quests.title: Wild Armour
description: Craft the first pelt chestplate.

quests.title: A Darker Mantle
description: Advance into dark pelt equipment.

quests.title: The White Pelt Pattern
description: Recover the pattern needed for white pelt equipment.

quests.title: Winter's Mantle
description: Finish the white pelt chestplate.

quests.title: A Woodland Harvest
quests.subtitle: Wards
description: Gather wolf berries for your supplies.

quests.title: Find the Wolfsbane
description: Prepare a finder for the protective herb.

quests.title: A Defensive Core
description: Prepare a diffuser core for an established settlement.

quests.title: A Stronger Ward
description: Improve the core before extending your defences.

quests.title: A Way Back
description: Keep the cure available if you decide to leave the werewolf path.

quests.title: A Companion's Bond
quests.subtitle: Pack
description: Prepare a charm for a single trusted minion.

quests.title: Train the Pack
description: Begin with a simple minion upgrade.

quests.title: An Experienced Companion
description: Improve the same companion rather than filling your base with followers.

quests.title: An Exceptional Guardian
description: Finish a specialised minion upgrade.

quests.title: Fire at Hand
quests.subtitle: Preparation
description: Prepare fire before hunting a mutant zombie; a fallen foe may not stay down.

quests.title: A Hunter's Defence
description: Bring a shield, food and a clear retreat route.

quests.title: A Clean Slate
description: Carry milk to remove harmful effects after the encounter. Remember that it also removes helpful effects.

quests.title: Put It to Rest
quests.subtitle: Zombie
description: Defeat a mutant zombie and survive the entire encounter.

quests.title: A Heavy Answer
description: Recover a hulk hammer from the hunt.

quests.title: A Storm of Arrows
quests.subtitle: Skeleton
description: Defeat a mutant skeleton without drawing it toward another player's home.

quests.title: The Archer's Skull
description: Recover the skull for the armour branch.

quests.title: Bones of the Hunt
description: Assemble the mutant skeleton chestplate.

quests.title: A Complete Pursuit
description: Continue the set with leggings.

quests.title: The Hunter's Stride
description: Finish the armour branch with boots.

quests.title: Keep Your Distance
quests.subtitle: Creeper
description: Defeat a mutant creeper in an open wilderness area.

quests.title: A Volatile Trophy
description: Recover the shard left by the encounter.

quests.title: Track the Little One
description: Prepare a tracker before keeping a creeper minion.

quests.title: The Unnatural Enderman
quests.subtitle: Enderman
description: Defeat a mutant enderman and keep watch for its tricks.

quests.title: A Hand Beyond Reach
description: Recover the endersoul hand and learn its reach away from protected builds.

quests.title: Beneath the Stone
quests.subtitle: Excavation
description: Break a fossil deposit and begin an excavation collection.

quests.title: A Trace of Life
description: Separate biological material from the dig.

quests.title: A Lost Garden
description: Reserve plant fossils for the botanical branch.

quests.title: Preserved in Tar
description: Recover tar-preserved material with room to escape the pit.

quests.title: The Frozen Record
description: Recover a specimen preserved in the cold.

quests.title: Read the Past
quests.subtitle: Laboratory
description: Build an analyzer and keep its outputs sorted.
The laboratory machines need a small Forge Energy supply. Connect them to your workshop power before starting a batch.

quests.title: The Genetic Record
description: Recover usable DNA through analysis.

quests.title: Life in a Vessel
description: Build a culture vat in a contained laboratory.

quests.title: A Second Beginning
description: Produce a dinosaur egg through the laboratory chain.

quests.title: Know Your Animal
description: Read the Dinopedia before hatching a creature. Prepare its food and enclosure first.

quests.title: A Reliable Food Supply
description: Place a feeder in the enclosure and keep it stocked.

quests.title: Another Branch of Life
description: Produce an embryo for the mammal branch.

quests.title: Seeds of Another Age
quests.subtitle: Botany
description: Recover fossil seeds during analysis.

quests.title: A Living Seed
description: Restore ancient plant material.

quests.title: Calamites Records
description: Recover the fossil sapling for the calamites branch.

quests.title: Cordaites Records
description: Recover another ancient tree specimen.

quests.title: A Prehistoric Palm
description: Add a palm specimen to the botanical collection.

quests.title: A Broken Relic
quests.subtitle: Archeology
description: Find a damaged ancient weapon.

quests.title: The Restorer's Bench
description: Build an archaeology worktable for damaged finds.

quests.title: An Edge Restored
description: Restore an ancient sword.

quests.title: Time Unearthed
description: Restore an ancient clock.

quests.title: Stories in Stone
description: Recover a stone tablet for your museum.

quests.title: Figures from the Past
description: Begin a collection of ancient figurines.

quests.title: The Scarab's Gleam
quests.subtitle: Expedition
description: Find a scarab gem before preparing the final expedition.

quests.title: Guardian of the Relic
description: Face the Anubite and recover the path forward.

quests.title: A Door to the Past
description: Recover the ancient key.

quests.title: Beyond the Ancient Door
description: Reach Anu's lair with your equipment repaired and supplies ready.

quests.title: The End of an Age
description: Defeat Anu and bring the story home.

quests.title: The Egg Archive
quests.subtitle: Collection
description: Complete the egg collection recorded by the Dinopedia's advancements.

quests.title: The Mammalian Record
description: Complete the embryo collection. A collection does not require keeping every creature loaded at once.

quests.title: A Small Safeguard
quests.subtitle: Wards
description: Recover a bezoar and inspect its protection before choosing your accessory slots.

quests.title: A Steady Constitution
description: Add vitamins to the collection of protective relics.

quests.title: Cleanse the Affliction
description: Combine the appropriate relics into a purification charm.

quests.title: The Ankh Pattern
description: Complete the charm's component branches before assembling it.

quests.title: The Complete Ward
description: Unite the ankh charm and shield branches.

quests.title: Stand Your Ground
quests.subtitle: Shield
description: Recover a cobalt shield as the foundation of the defensive branch.

quests.title: A Darkened Skull
description: Prepare an obsidian skull for the next combination.

quests.title: A Reinforced Guard
description: Combine the shield and skull into the obsidian shield.

quests.title: A Hero's Guard
description: Finish the hero shield branch.

quests.title: A Clearer View
quests.subtitle: Senses
description: Recover sunglasses for the sensory protection branch.

quests.title: An Echoing Lens
description: Find the sculk lens and study its effect.

quests.title: Shades of the Deep
description: Combine the sensory relics into sculk shades.

quests.title: A Weightless Heart
description: Recover a shulker heart from your travels.

quests.title: A Quickened Clock
description: Find the clock required by this branch.

quests.title: A Stranger Timepiece
description: Combine the clock and heart into a shulked clock.

quests.title: The Mechanist's Grip
quests.subtitle: Combat
description: Build a mechanical glove and choose how it fits your combat equipment.

quests.title: A Dragon's Claw
description: Recover the dragon claw for the next combination.

quests.title: A Sharper Machine
description: Complete the mechanical claw.

quests.title: An Echoing Grip
description: Finish the echo glove branch.

quests.title: An Archer's Relic
quests.subtitle: Quiver
description: Prepare a magic quiver for a ranged equipment set.

quests.title: Poisoned Precision
description: Advance into the venomous quiver branch.

quests.title: Arrows of the Forge
description: Complete a molten quiver as an alternative ranged specialisation.

quests.title: A Lighter Step
quests.subtitle: Travel
description: Recover a balloon for movement-focused equipment.

quests.title: Above the Obstacles
description: Prepare high jumpers for exploration.

quests.title: Across the Dunes
description: Build dune treads for the travel branch.

quests.title: A Heated Path
description: Advance into blazing treads.

quests.title: An Ender Road
description: Complete enderian treads.

quests.title: The Wanderer's Mantle
description: Finish a nature's mantle for your exploration collection.

quests.title: An Ender Warding
quests.subtitle: Scarf
description: Recover an enderian scarf before pursuing its stronger forms.

quests.title: A Truer Pattern
description: Complete the true enderian scarf.

quests.title: A Golden Finish
description: Finish the gilded scarf branch.

title: Dragon Mounts - A Bond in the Sky

quests.title: Food for a Friend
quests.subtitle: Preparation
description: Prepare fish before approaching a young dragon.

quests.title: A Safe Enclosure
description: Prepare a lead and a roomy enclosure away from busy machines.

quests.title: A Rider's Equipment
description: Prepare a saddle before your companion is ready to carry you.

quests.title: An Unhatched Promise
quests.subtitle: Bond
description: Recover a dragon egg and choose a safe place to hatch it. Its surroundings can shape the breed.

quests.title: Earn Its Trust
description: Tame a Dragon Mounts dragon yourself.

quests.title: The First Ride
description: Mount a Dragon Mounts dragon.

quests.title: Above the Clouds
description: Ride your dragon above Y150. Choose clear skies and keep a safe landing in sight.
